Fieldwork

See how people really use the city.

FIELDWORK by Earth5R puts you on the ground in your own neighbourhood, working with the community on local environmental problems while a mentor checks the field data behind every finding. Study the street before you draw it.

Learn more at earth5r.org
jobs_ad_html: Fieldwork Still studying, or between offers? FIELDWORK by Earth5R is a mentored fellowship for school and university students. You work on a live Earth5R project near home and come away with a verified record of the field work. earth5r.org/fieldwork
jobs_intro: Architecture and urban design roles checked today, green building included. Every listing links to the original posting. Portfolio not included.
